reason: The citation is verbatim correct (HilltopVillagePlugin.java:158-159; NpcManager.java:301-305 logs and returns void) and cleanupOrphans does run immediately after, skipping only `entity == npc` (NpcManager.java:320). But the described harm is overstated and partly unreachable. ShopManager (and therefore a brand-new NpcManager with npc == null) is constructed at HilltopVillagePlugin.java:119, so at line 158 there is never a stale npc and the cross-world mid-match guard at NpcManager.java:75-84 cannot fire (no arena has a match at onEnable; comment at HilltopVillagePlugin.java:162-165 confirms). The only reachable false return is `location.getWorld() == null` (NpcManager.java:71), which requires the arena world itself to be unloadable; that world's entities are not in Bukkit.getWorlds() and are therefore NOT deleted, so the configured shop entity survives to the next successful start. What cleanupOrphans does delete in that state is by definition a PDC-marked orphan in a different, loaded world — the method's documented job (NpcManager.java:308-314, P2-25), not the current shop. 'No shop NPC at all' is also a supported state: respawnFromConfig returns silently at NpcManager.java:296 when no arena has a shop-npc, so absence is a deployable-configuration condition rather than a degraded core module, and `/hilltop deploy setshop` (HilltopCommandHandler.java:1189) or the wizard rebuilds it without a restart. The genuine residual issue is only that respawnFromConfig's boolean is discarded so a failed spawn leaves only a log line — low severity, not medium.
counter_evidence: NpcManager.java:71 `if (location == null || location.getWorld() == null) return false;` | NpcManager.java:296 `if (target == null) return;` | NpcManager.java:318-322 `for (World world : Bukkit.getWorlds()) { for (Entity entity : world.getEntities()) { if (entity == npc) continue; if (entity.getPersistentDataContainer().has(shopNpcKey, PersistentDataType.BYTE)) { entity.remove();` | NpcManager.java:262-266 `public boolean isShopNpc(Entity entity) { ... return entity.getPersistentDataContainer().has(shopNpcKey, PersistentDataType.BYTE); }` | HilltopVillagePlugin.java:119-120 `this.shopManager = new ShopManager(this, languageManager); this.shopManager.reload();`
